name: Energy Transmutation (Akashic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental Essence.

Benefit(s): You may use the Elemental Essence feat on veils which lack the acid, cold, electricity, or fire descriptor. The veil gains the chosen descriptor and any damage of the original type dealt by that veil is changed to the new type. If you invest a second point of essence into a veil with the Elemental Essence feat, you may select a second energy type, causing the veil to deal half of its damage as the first damage type and the other half as the second damage type.

You gain 1 point of essence.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you must choose a different energy type.
